items.text: The House voted to pass the Advancing Telehealth Beyond COVID-19 Act. Telehealth is vital to rural communities South Dakota and should be a permanent option for Americans. I was proud to support this legislation to support health care providers and patients.
I joined the Independent Insurance Agents of South Dakota to answer some questions on crop insurance and federal ag policy updates. Thanks for having me @IIASoDak! https://t.co/IS6LfTzN9B

Do you ever watch news coverage of Congress and wonder what it would be like inside the walls of the Congress? Come intern in my office, gain work experience, and skills to help your career. Applications close November 1st. https://t.co/soWnRFYEkP

Timber Lake High School welcomed me for a student assembly today. They had great questions about the military service academies and what I’m working on in Congress. I reminded them the most important muscle to exercise is their mind. Thanks for having me! https://t.co/tf4fuuNu7C

I met with the National Guard Enlisted Association to discuss their end-of-year priorities. Some of those priorities are the importance of health coverage for reservists and the ability of Guard and Reserve members to qualify for federal education benefits. https://t.co/jwXEX477oz

The Biden Admin’s COVID-19 vaccine mandate was a overreach of federal power & limited freedoms of our frontline workers. This mandate unnecessarily exacerbated the healthcare workforce shortage.

Yesterday, @HouseGOP passed Freedom for Health Care Workers Act to end this mandate.

COVID-era regulations continue to make operations more difficult & expensive for nursing homes—S.D. Association of Healthcare Organizations & Good Samaritan know that firsthand. We need to roll back these requirements. Great to meet with them & show them the Speaker’s balcony! https://t.co/lEYNk8svx3
Checked out all the produce Happy Hydros grows with their hydroponic system. They deliver to local retail, restaurants, hospitals, and schools. https://t.co/2CbgrjxQs4

Three South Dakota rural community hospitals made the top 20 list. The work by staff at Brookings, Watertown, and Mitchell provide great care to their patients. Their service is rightly honored!

https://t.co/fab7zn31CH
My thoughts on the @committeeonccp’s tabletop exercise on a Chinese invasion of Taiwan. https://t.co/Ikr8UyDfPF

The Biden Admin’s stabilizing brace rule restricts the exercise of Second Amendment rights and risks making felons out of law-abiding citizens. 

@HouseGOP passed a bill to oppose this rule & I joined my colleagues to send a letter to the ATF urging them to repeal it.

87% of small businesses want more health insurance options for their employees without offering a traditional group plan. 

@HouseGOP just passed the CHOICE Arrangement Act to ensure flexibility and affordability of healthcare plans for small businesses.

Oyate Health Center’s new clinic opened in January and provides service to tribal members from throughout the region. I was able to help prevent the IHS telehealth contract from lapsing last year, allowing OHC to continue serving quality care to their patients. https://t.co/sWQa7k9jvr

Thank you Jerilyn Church, Executive Director of the Great Plains Tribal Heath Board, for testifying on behalf of my discussion draft to restore accountability in the Indian Health Service. I look forward to working together to improve the delivery of healthcare in Indian country. https://t.co/gR1gXKhSap

Our veterans have given their best. Our VA healthcare workers do their best. The investment in the Black Hills VA CBOC is worthy of these veterans and caregivers. It was honor to join for the grand opening. https://t.co/TiUgiG58TU

In their 45th year of service, Horizon Health Care provides care for more than 28,000 people across South Dakota. We talked about the work I am doing in DC to protect rural healthcare and 340B programs so Horizon can continue to provide quality health care to their patients. https://t.co/jAKt5dpiSQ

I visited the Avera Grassland Health Campus in Mitchell. We talked about my support for the 340B program and telehealth. Dr. Rockwell explained their workforce sources for healthcare professionals and employee recruitment to make sure patients are continue to have someone to care for them.

Prairie Lakes provides care for 90,000 people in South Dakota and Minnesota and made the National Rural Health Association’s Top 20 rural and community hospitals. We discussed the importance of software infrastructure, caring for all individuals, and delivering services to patients.

South Dakota Ag & Rural Leadership Foundation is in D.C. to talk about rural and farm policy like rural health care, immigration, and workforce programs. We also discussed the Farm Bill, which I hope we can get done soon. https://t.co/qVleTzfqjJ

South Dakota Pork Producers and I talked about priorities for the Farm Bill and trade and keeping foreign animal disease out of the U.S. Protecting the health of our livestock is critical for food security. https://t.co/4u5J7jB6Yk
I gave the Independent Insurance Agents of South Dakota a quick tour of the Capitol as we discussed risk mitigation and insurance programs. https://t.co/dDEkvCNnsX

I enjoyed meeting with Avera Health's new CEO, Jim Dover. We discussed the growth in S.D. and improvements being made at Avera to complement that growth. We also discussed the shortage of nurses in S.D. and our shared opposition to CMS rules that would exacerbate this issue. https://t.co/xz3F9mBEuU

South Dakota Association of Health Care Organizations and I talked about 340B drug programs that I support, site-neutral payment policies, and our nursing shortage. We have nearly 1,600 open positions and we discussed ways to support the occupation in South Dakota. https://t.co/i4Ac5UHcyy

I met with Avera’s General Counsel who is here with the Catholic Health Association. They gave me an update on what they're working on and we talked about how important the 340B drug program is to South Dakota. https://t.co/W56fv01Znf
